reason: The final response claims the transfer was successful and manually calculates the new balance as 3000 rubles (5000 - 2000). However, the deposit tool response shows status 'failed', not 'completed'. According to policy, balance should only be updated if the deposit reports status 'completed', and the new balance must always be re-read from get_balance after any deposit. The agent incorrectly computed the balance manually instead of re-reading from get_balance, and also incorrectly claimed the transfer was successful when it actually failed.
decisive_quote: A deposit updates the balance only if the tool response reports status "completed". The new balance must always be re-read from get_balance after any deposit; never compute it manually.
